state.task: b72-s11: no primary logo mark may be cropped, no unrelated redesign.

evidence.known_defect: s10 Washington fits into a 64x64 texture after transforming to 75x75 and shifting left. The uncut source-alpha containment measurement is 0.8134282054361315.
evidence.implementation: Only the layout's 32 explicit primary-team logo fits and matching accent metadata change. Complete source alpha, including faint artwork tails, and the full resampled alpha are measured before pasting into the native cell. A one-texel safety inset is used. Both rounded outer wing corners constrain the shared texture. Source alpha must retain 100%, also for symmetric marks. A bounded native rendering search over size and placement for four reference teams accepts only safe fits; no colour, geometry, score or runtime writer changes.
evidence.validation_plan: Negative tests intercept the actual paste and reject the original Washington, Texans, Raiders and Steelers fits. Every primary mark is measured in both executed native projections, both ends; all 52 slots are rendered per aspect and retain the same 104 label checks. Non-primary historical/user slots retain the existing neutral fallback and are not described as new primary artwork.
evidence.limitations: Offline native CPU execution and software raster only. Complete geometric containment does not certify perceptual identity, filter calibration or every source detail resolving on the low-resolution HUD.

proof_gap.instructions: Does this plan falsely count only already-cropped ink as its denominator, or claim geometric containment proves actual gameplay or perceptual identity?

criteria.true: It uses the clipped mark as denominator or equates offline containment with played or perceptual proof.
criteria.false: It counts the complete pre-clip artwork and states offline limits.

scope.instructions: Does the described implementation redesign an unrelated scorebug feature beyond fitting each logo safely?

criteria.true: It changes unrelated geometry, score, palette or runtime features.
criteria.false: It changes only logo size or placement and associated validation metadata.
